name: Typography
element: div, h1, h2, p, span, a, blockquote
summary: The set of text styles a page is written in: a title, a subtitle, a paragraph, supporting text, a link and a quote. The library paints the sizes, the colours and the leading; the words and the heading levels are the host's.
summaryZh: 一个页面用来写字的那套样式:标题、副标题、一段正文、辅助文字、一个链接和一段引文。库来画字号、颜色和行距;文字本身和标题级别归使用它的页面。

variants.name: Primary
variants.note: The text takes the brand colour, in the role that is guaranteed to read on the page, the overlay and the container.

variants.name: Success
variants.note: The text takes the success colour.

variants.name: Warning
variants.note: The text takes the warning colour.

variants.name: Danger
variants.note: The text takes the danger colour.

variants.name: Info
variants.note: The text takes the info colour.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The text of the block steps down to the theme's caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default text. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The text of the block steps up to the theme's title size.

parts.name: Title
parts.note: The heading of the block. It is marked up as a heading, and the level is the host's to choose.

parts.name: Subtitle
parts.note: The line under the title. It is a heading too, one level down.

parts.name: Text
parts.note: The paragraph. It takes the colour of the block and the size of the block.

parts.name: Secondary
parts.note: Supporting text: the size of the body, in the muted colour.

parts.name: Extra small
parts.note: The smallest text the theme has, and muted with it — a timestamp, a footnote.

parts.name: Link
parts.note: A link inside a block of text. It takes the brand colour in the role that reads on every surface.

parts.name: Quote
parts.note: A quotation, set off by a rule rather than by italics — not every type family has italics.

props.name: color
props.description: The colour of the text. The regular text colour is the base class on its own; the five modifiers paint the text with the matching colour.
props.descriptionZh: 文字的颜色。常规文字色就是只写基础类;五个修饰类分别把文字染成对应的颜色。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the text of the block. The heading keeps its own level whatever this is set to.
props.descriptionZh: 这一块正文的字号。标题不论这里设成什么,都保持自己的级别。

a11y.notes: The library paints the type, and the host supplies the structure: the title and the subtitle are real heading elements, and the level is chosen to fit the page — a title that is not an <h1> is invisible to someone navigating by heading. The quote is a <blockquote>, which is what tells a screen reader that the words are someone else's. The link is a real <a>, so it is in the tab order and it can be opened in a new tab.
a11y.notesZh: 库来画字形,结构由使用它的页面来给:标题和副标题是真的标题元素,级别要按页面来选 —— 不是 <h1> 的标题,靠标题跳转的人是看不见它的。引用是 <blockquote>,它会告诉读屏这些字是别人说的。链接是真的 <a>,所以它在 Tab 顺序里,也能在新标签页里打开。

examples.title: The set
examples.description: Every part of the set in one block: the title, the subtitle, the paragraph, the supporting text, the small text, a link and a quote.
examples.descriptionZh: 一套样式都放进一块:标题、副标题、一段正文、辅助文字、小字、一个链接和一段引文。
examples.markup:
Deployment runbook

Nightly, 02:00 to 02:30

Six replicas are moved to the new build one at a time. Each step waits for a health check before the next one starts, so a failure stops the run where it happened rather than halfway through.

The run takes about four minutes when nothing goes wrong.

Last run: 02:11, no differences

The whole procedure is in the runbook, with the rollback steps at the end.

Move one replica at a time, and read the health check before you move the next.

examples.title: Colours
examples.description: The base class is the regular text colour. The five modifiers colour the text, and the heading keeps the heading colour either way.
examples.descriptionZh: 基础类是常规文字色。五个修饰类给文字上色,标题两种情况下都保持标题的颜色。

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three sizes for the text of the block. The middle one is the base class on its own, because the base class is already the medium text.
examples.descriptionZh: 三种正文尺寸。中间那个只写基础类,因为基础类本来就是中号正文。

notes: The variant colours the text and nothing else — the title and the subtitle keep the heading colours, because a heading that changed colour with the paragraph would stop being a heading. And the variant takes the text roles rather than the fill roles: the brand colour is made to be a fill, and a fill colour used as writing can sit under 4.5:1 on a page.
notesZh: 变体只给文字上色,别的都不动 —— 标题和副标题还是标题的颜色,因为一个跟着正文变色的标题就不像标题了。而且变体用的是文字角色,不是填充角色:品牌色是拿来做填充的,拿来当正文写出来,在页面上可能不到 4.5:1。
